messages:
Alex: deploybot flagged release 2026.03.25-17 — preflight failed: keystore path mismatch staging vs prod (trailing slash). Rollout held. ping @SRE-Oncall @Priya

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: releasecheck failed: keystore_path normalization mismatch (code 412). Command: `rtool preflight --release 2026.03.25-17`

Priya: i caught something similar in canary yesterday but agent auto-fixed it. looks like prod keystore-service v2.4.0 changed path handling (strips trailing slash). staging mock normalizer kept the slash so it passed there.

SRE-Oncall: +1. root cause: keystore runtime path normalization change in v2.4.0. options: A) revert runtime on prod (fast, <1h), B) hotfix release to strip trailing slashes in config, C) add compatibility shim in keystore service. Revert is quickest but loses v2.4 telemetry.

Lina: hotfix is tiny: pre-resolve path with `.rstrip('/')` before lookup. can ship as `hf1` and canary for 15m. low blast radius.

Alex: change window in ~2h. if we hotfix now, need canary + 15m observation. rollback plan?

Priya: rollback plan prepared: `scripts/revert-keystore-2.4.sh` will pin image back to `keystore:2.3.9` and restart. monitoring hooks watch for token errors + 5xx. manual trigger or `ops rollback` automation available.

SRE-Oncall: prefer hotfix + canary given size. i'll kick off canary in prod-us-west (2 pods) and monitor metrics: 5xx, token-error-rate, ksm latency. @Alex update release notes and pin manifest to the patched image tag to avoid auto-roll.

Alex: ack. updating release notes: "Prod keystore path normalization compatibility hotfix — strips trailing slash to preserve staging parity; released as 2026.03.25-17-hf1". will pin manifest image to `keystore:2.4.0-patch1`. adding rollback steps to notes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary promotion for `2026.03.25-17-hf1` to prod-us-west-canary. healthchecks pending.

Lina: canary smoke passed after 6m — no 5xx, auth logs normal. proceeding to gradual rollout :thumbsup:

SRE-Oncall: rolling to 20% now. monitoring dashboards green. shutdown plan ready if metrics jump.

Alex: adding change-window note in calendar and notifying support. after rollout we'll add a normalization unit test to preflight and a deploybot lint for path normalization diffs. also marking this release as pinned in deploy manifest.

Priya: filing INF-4321 to add keystore path normalization test in CI and deploybot rule to detect path-normalization diffs. thanks all.
